neighbours.label: the slot that opens a phrase widening the scope to the whole collective: the word before 'a whole' in 'as a whole' and before 'large' in 'at large'
fire: The reform will help farmers and, in the end, the country as a whole.
His ideas were ignored by his colleagues and by the public at large.
We need to think about the school as a whole, not just one class.
The scandal damaged the party and the political system at large.
Critics praised the second act, but the film as a whole felt long.
These cuts hurt local libraries and the community at large.
The league as a whole has become more competitive in recent years.
The disease threatens not only the patients but society at large.
quiet: The reform will help farmers and, in the end, their children too.
His ideas were ignored by his colleagues and by his own students.
We need to think about the school library, not just one class.
The scandal damaged the party and several of its leaders.
Critics praised the second act, but the ending felt long.
These cuts hurt local libraries and the people who use them.
The league has become more competitive in recent years.
The disease threatens not only the patients but their nurses.

predictions: 'as a whole' and 'at large' sentences 0.3-0.6; the same sentences without the scope phrase below 0.05
notes: Card: ' at' (world at large), ' as' (as a whole) x4, ',' before respectively, ' ago', ' time' in for the first time; suppresses alike/altogether/respectively. Probe: 'the economy as a whole' 0.450, 'the world at large' 0.378; 'respectively' 0.083, 'a few years ago' 0.033 (these parts of the card did not reproduce, so they are left out); controls 0.008-0.015.
